items.title: 主从复合句中的时态呼应规则
items.brief: 主句过去时，名词性从句退到相应过去时

concept.summary: 主句谓语为过去时，宾语从句、表语从句、主语从句的谓语一般要后移为相应的过去时：现在时变过去时，过去时或现在完成时变过去完成时，将来时变过去将来时。呼应只约束名词性从句，状语从句与定语从句按各自的时间关系独立选时，不受主句牵制。客观真理、历史事实、现在仍然成立的状态以及带 now 等现在时间状语的句子保留现在时，这是呼应规则最重要的出口。

sections.p: 后移是系统性的，按时态轴整体向过去移动一格，而不是随意替换。记住五组对应即可覆盖绝大多数考题。
bullets: is / does → was / did
is doing → was doing
has done → had done
will do → would do
can / may / must → could / might / must（must 无过去式，靠语境）

sections.p: 时态呼应作用于宾语从句、表语从句、主语从句与同位语从句。状语从句按逻辑时间独立选时，定语从句按先行词所指的实际时间选时，两者都不向主句看齐。
bullets: 宾语从句：He said he had finished the report.
时间状语从句：He said he had seen her when he was in Paris.（when 从句用过去时，与主句同层）
定语从句：He told me about a book that is now a bestseller.（书现在仍畅销，用 is）
比较状语从句：She worked harder than she does now.

sections.h: 四类必须保留现在时的例外
sections.p: 例外不是随意破例，而是因为从句内容的时间定位不依赖主句：它指向永恒真理、已定格的历史、说话时仍存在的状态，或被 now 一类状语锚定在现在。
bullets: 客观真理：The teacher told us that light travels faster than sound.
历史事实：He said that the war ended in 1945.
现在仍成立：She said she is still working on the same project.
现在时间状语：He said he is busy now.

examples.en: He said he had finished the report the week before.
examples.zh: 他说他前一周就把报告写完了。
examples.note: 主句 said 为过去时，从句动作更早，现在完成后移为过去完成。

examples.en: She told me she would be late for the meeting.
examples.zh: 她告诉我她开会要迟到。
examples.note: will be 随主句过去时后移为 would be。

examples.en: The teacher explained that water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
examples.zh: 老师解释水在一百摄氏度沸腾。
examples.note: 客观真理不受呼应约束，保留一般现在时 boils。

examples.en: He said he is working on a new novel now.
examples.zh: 他说他现在正在写一部新小说。
examples.note: now 把动作锚定在说话当下，从句可用现在进行时。

examples.en: He said he will come back the next day.
examples.note: 主句 said 为过去时，从句的将来须后移为 would come。

examples.en: The teacher told the pupils that the sun rose in the east.
examples.zh: 老师告诉学生太阳从东方升起。
examples.note: 客观真理不参与后移，应保留一般现在时 rises。

examples.en: He said he can swim across the river.
examples.note: 主句为过去时，情态动词 can 应后移为 could。

pitfalls.wrong: She said she will call back soon.
pitfalls.right: She said she would call back soon.
pitfalls.why: 主句 said 是过去时，宾语从句的将来必须后移为过去将来，will 变 would。

pitfalls.wrong: The teacher told the pupils that the sun rose in the east.
pitfalls.right: The teacher told the pupils that the sun rises in the east.
pitfalls.why: 客观真理的时间定位与主句无关，不参与后移，须保留一般现在时。

pitfalls.wrong: He told me he has lost his keys and could not get in.
pitfalls.right: He told me he had lost his keys and could not get in.
pitfalls.why: 丢钥匙发生在 told 之前，属“过去的过去”，现在完成后移为过去完成。

contrast.withTitle: 特殊句式中的时态固定
contrast.diff: 呼应规则处理从句随主句后移；特殊句式是句式本身锁死某一时态、根本不参与后移的结构。

concept.mnemonic: 主句过去，从句退一格；真理、历史、现在、now 四不退。

core: 后移五组：is→was，is doing→was doing，has done→had done，will do→would do，can→could
只约束名词性从句，状语从句与定语从句按实际时间独立选时
四类例外：客观真理、历史事实、现在仍成立、带 now 等现在状语
从句动作早于主句，用过去完成时
从句动作晚于主句，用过去将来时
review.trigger: 看到主句是过去时 → 先看从句类型 → 名词性从句后移，状语与定语从句不动

quickCheck.q: He said light ___ (travel) faster than sound. 填什么？
主句过去时，从句的 will 变什么？
定语从句要不要跟主句后移？
quickCheck.a: 不要，按先行词所指的实际时间选时。

drills.stem: He told me that he ___ the novel twice before the film came out.
drills.explain: 读小说发生在 told 之前，属“过去的过去”，现在完成后移为过去完成 had read。
drills.trap: has read 保留了现在完成时，与主句过去时以及 before 从句的过去时都接不上。

drills.stem: She said she ___ (be) busy at that moment.
drills.hint: at that moment 指过去的某一时刻。
drills.explain: 主句 said 为过去时，at that moment 指向过去，系动词 be 后移为 was。

drills.stem: The teacher told us that light traveled much faster than sound.
drills.answer: The teacher told us that light travels much faster than sound.
accept: The teacher told us that light travels much faster than sound.
drills.explain: 光速快于声速是客观真理，时间定位与主句无关，不参与时态后移，须用一般现在时 travels。

drills.stem: Our teacher explained that the First World War ___ in 1914.
drills.explain: 1914 是已定格的历史时间，事件本身用一般过去时即可，不需要再往前推成过去完成时。
drills.trap: had broken out 误把历史事实当成“过去的过去”，句中并无更早的过去参照点。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: He said that he would come back the next day.
drills.explain: 主句 said 为过去时，从句的将来后移为 would come，tomorrow 在间接引语中改为 the next day。

drills.stem: 老师告诉我们地球围绕太阳转。
drills.answer: The teacher told us that the earth goes around the sun.
drills.explain: 地球绕日运行是客观真理，虽主句为 told，从句仍用一般现在时 goes。

items.title: 特殊句式中的时态固定
items.brief: 固定句式锁死时态，不参与后移

concept.summary: 部分句式把时态锁死在某一形式，既不受主句时态牵制，也不参与时态呼应后移。识别信号是句式本身：It is the first time that 后接现在完成时，It was the first time that 后接过去完成时；It is high time that 后用过去时或 should do；hardly...when 与 no sooner...than 主句用过去完成时并倒装，从句用一般过去时；It is/has been + 时间段 + since 从句用一般过去时。

sections.h: 第几次：It is the first time that
sections.p: 该句式的时态由主句的 is 或 was 决定，从句一律用完成体：主句现在时配现在完成时，主句过去时配过去完成时。同类还有 It is the best film I have ever seen。
bullets: It is the first time that he has driven a truck.
It was the first time that he had driven a truck.
This is the most interesting book I have ever read.

sections.h: 虚拟类：It is time 与 would rather
sections.p: It is (high/about) time that 后的从句要用虚拟语气，动词用过去时或 should + 原形，表示“早该做了”。would rather 后接从句同样用过去时表现在或将来。
bullets: It is high time that we took action.
It is time that we should leave.
I would rather you came tomorrow.
× It is high time that we will start.

sections.p: hardly/scarcely...when 与 no sooner...than 表示“刚一……就……”，主句用过去完成时且因否定副词提前而部分倒装，从句用一般过去时。since 句式则以现在为参照，从句用一般过去时。
bullets: Hardly had he sat down when the phone rang.
No sooner had the bell rung than the students rushed out.
It is three years since he moved here.
It has been ten years since we last met.

examples.en: It is the first time that she has spoken in public.
examples.zh: 这是她第一次当众发言。
examples.note: 主句 is 为现在时，从句用现在完成时 has spoken。

examples.en: It was the first time that they had seen the sea.
examples.zh: 那是他们第一次看到大海。
examples.note: 主句 was 为过去时，从句用过去完成时 had seen。

examples.en: It is high time that we took action.
examples.note: It is high time that 后接虚拟语气，用一般过去时 took。

examples.en: Hardly had the film begun when the power went off.
examples.note: hardly 置于句首引起部分倒装，主句用过去完成时，从句用一般过去时。

examples.en: It has been five years since we last met.
examples.zh: 我们上次见面到现在已经五年了。
examples.note: since 从句用一般过去时 last met，主句用现在完成时表持续。

examples.en: It is the first time that I saw such a beautiful sunset.
examples.zh: 这是我第一次看到这么美的日落。
examples.note: 主句 is 为现在时，从句须用现在完成时 have seen，不能用一般过去时。

examples.en: It is high time that we will start the meeting.
examples.note: 该句式要求虚拟语气，用 started 或 should start，不能用 will start。

examples.en: No sooner he had arrived than it started to rain.
examples.note: no sooner 置于句首要部分倒装，应写成 No sooner had he arrived。

pitfalls.wrong: It was the first time that he has visited Japan.
pitfalls.right: It was the first time that he had visited Japan.
pitfalls.why: 主句 was 为过去时，that 从句的完成体要相应后移为过去完成时。

pitfalls.wrong: Hardly he had finished speaking when the audience applauded.
pitfalls.right: Hardly had he finished speaking when the audience applauded.
pitfalls.why: hardly 是否定副词，置于句首时助动词 had 必须提到主语前，构成部分倒装。

pitfalls.wrong: It is high time that we go to bed.
pitfalls.right: It is high time that we went to bed.
pitfalls.why: 该句式要求虚拟语气，从句动词用过去时或 should + 原形，不能用一般现在时。

contrast.withTitle: 主从复合句中的时态呼应规则
contrast.diff: 呼应规则让从句跟着主句后移；特殊句式相反，句式本身规定时态，主句怎么变都不影响从句形式。

concept.mnemonic: 第几次用完成，该做未做用过去；hardly 提前要倒装，since 从句用过去。

core: It is the first time that + 现在完成时；It was the first time that + 过去完成时
It is high time that + 过去时或 should do
hardly/scarcely...when、no sooner...than：主句过去完成时并倒装，从句一般过去时
It is/has been + 时间段 + since + 一般过去时
固定句式的时态由句式决定，不随主句后移
review.trigger: 看到 the first time / high time / hardly / no sooner / since → 先套句式规定的时态，再考虑其他成分

quickCheck.q: It was the first time that he ___ (visit) Japan. 填什么？
It is high time that we ___ (leave). 填什么？
No sooner 置于句首要不要倒装？

drills.stem: It is the first time that the little boy ___ a horse.
drills.explain: It is the first time that 句式中主句为现在时，从句固定用现在完成时，表示到说话时为止的第一次。
drills.trap: had ridden 对应的是主句为 was 的情形，与这里的 is 不匹配。

drills.stem: It was the third time that she ___ (visit) the museum that year.
drills.hint: 主句是 was，从句的完成体要相应后移。
drills.explain: 主句 was 为过去时，It was the...time that 后的从句用过去完成时 had visited。

drills.stem: No sooner he had left the office than the phone rang.
drills.answer: No sooner had he left the office than the phone rang.
accept: No sooner had he left the office than the phone rang.
drills.explain: no sooner 是否定副词短语，置于句首时主句要部分倒装，把助动词 had 提到主语 he 之前。

drills.stem: It is high time that the government ___ stricter measures.
drills.explain: It is high time that 后的从句要用虚拟语气，动词用一般过去时 took，或 should take。
drills.trap: takes 是按一般现在时规则类推的结果，忽略了该句式的虚拟要求。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: It has been ten years since he left his hometown.
drills.explain: since 从句用一般过去时 left，主句用现在完成时 has been 表示从那时到现在的持续。

drills.answer: This is the first time that I have been to Beijing.
drills.explain: This is the first time that 后固定用现在完成时；表示“去过某地”用 have been to，不用 have gone to。
